text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: It has read everything we ever wrote.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0072b2

g.text: It has never read a river.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: The machines being handed decisions about the physical world learned that world from our writing

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: about it. The machines that can actually read the planet's instruments are hundreds of times smaller —

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: and they are not connected to the ones making the calls.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00

g.text: TRAINED ON WHAT WE SAID ABOUT THE WORLD

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: General-purpose frontier models — the systems being given

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: operational authority over food, water, freight and the grid

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0072b2

g.text: TRAINED ON WHAT THE WORLD RECORDED

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Earth-observation foundation models — the systems that can

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: read satellites, rivers, air and land directly

g.text: NOT WIRED TOGETHER

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: As of August 2026, no Earth-observation foundation model sits inside an autonomous decision loop with

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: authority over a physical system. Where the two have been joined at all — Google's Earth AI and its

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: Geospatial Reasoning agent — it is limited-release, decision-support, and human-in-the-loop by design.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Sources — Llama 3.1 405B: Meta AI, July 2024; 405B parameters, more than 15T training tokens; the largest frontier model with an officially published

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: parameter count. GPT-4 ~1.8T: SemiAnalysis estimate, 2023, never confirmed by OpenAI, shown faded for that reason. Prithvi-EO-2.0: NASA and IBM,

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: arXiv:2412.02732; 300M and 600M variants trained on 4.2M global time-series samples from NASA's Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 archive. Clay v1.5:

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Clay Foundation, open source. Aurora: Microsoft Research, Nature 641 (2025) — an Earth-system model rather than an imagery model, shown for scale.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Not shown, for cause — AlphaEarth Foundations (Google DeepMind, 2025) and TerraMind (IBM and ESA, 2025) are among the strongest models in this

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: class, but neither publishes a parameter count, so neither can be honestly placed on this axis. Their absence understates the right-hand column, not the

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: left. Checked 2 August 2026.
